Detailed Definition: Sum of nine indicator variables which are: 1 if net income (ib) greater 0; 1 if net cash flow (oancf) greater 0; 1 if return on assets (ib/at) increased relative to previous year; 1 if net cash flow greater net income; 1 if long-term debt to assets (dltt/at) declined over the previous year;  if current assets to current liabilities (act/lct) increased over the previous year; 1 if ebit/sale (ebit = ib + txt + xint) increased over the previous year; 1 if revenue to assets increased over the previous year; 1 if shrout $\leq$ shrout last year. Include highest quintile of book-to-market only.  Exclude if missing any of the input variables.
